check: Supplemental F07 complete clockwise tool cycles at both carrier travel limits
centered_case: Covered by the tracked production service script; no centered results duplicated here
coverage: 102 sampled clearance poses per carrier limit: rear infeed, airborne alignment, entry, two clockwise tightening strokes, disengagement, airborne re-indexing, re-engagement and rear retreat. No continuous swept-volume claim.
prerequisites: Fixed housing quadrants, seam strips and motor hood absent together with F15/F16/F17 cover hardware; optional B07 encoder absent. Retain hub, bearing, wheel, columns, sleeves and all other registered hardware. F07 screw axes remain fixed in M01 while the carrier moves.
derivation_procedure: Generate the normal production service commands and coverage with scripts/build_assembly_checks.py; use an isolated copy or intercept Path.write_text when generation is not authorized.
Read production service_checks from cad/hardware-check-coverage.json. Associate successive inspect.clearance commands in cad/support-access-checks.json with those labels in order.

Walk the production service commands from the beginning. Keep every non-inspection command, but omit preceding inspect.* commands. Start retaining inspect.clearance commands at creation of TEST F07 side key 0, preserving the matching labels.
Stop immediately before creation of the first TEST M55 backing strip body. This retains the production hardware population, service preparation and complete F07 commands for both screws.

Immediately before creation of TEST F07 side key 0, insert the exact offset_move recorded for this case. Do not move M01, the F07 screws, rotor or columns. All 17 moving body names are recorded in offset_move.

Run the resulting temporary script with /Applications/SolidCraft.app/Contents/MacOS/solidcraft-cli run TEMP.json --in michelaingelo.sc --results --quiet --json-out TEMP.results.json. Do not pass --save.
For each retained F07 inspection, record the nearest reported pair, overlaps, unchecked list and truncation flag. Aggregate the minimum by screw and phase as below.
limits: The imported arm and purchased components retain the production simplifications/exclusions.
The 12 mm tool is a candidate envelope, not a selected commercial key. Measure the actual bend, shaft/handle section, available socket engagement and torque capability.
The minimum 0.50 mm sleeve clearance and 1.00 mm fully lifted inward-handle/wheel clearance are nominal, before actual tool and assembly tolerances.
Actual harness clearance and two successive tightening strokes to the required clamp torque must be demonstrated physically.
